scope: G04/G05 ancestor visibility/editability across ordinary local form controls, draft recovery, creation and member edits

source.evidence: 2.2.6 describes field visibility/editability on member access; workflow-node overrides are stated separately. This batch preserves workflow behavior and does not claim workflow parity.

changes: Tab runtime forwards its readonly constraint to children and row controls; FieldControl readonly also disables editing directly.
Existing scopeFields can project inherited tab permission flags for input acceptance; recovery and creation reuse it without changing configuration/reference callers.
Draft recovery preserves hidden and readonly values; creation cannot inject child rows through a restricted tab.
Member edits check container visibility before descending; showing and editing a container in the same permitted command remains supported.
